import csv, collections
cool='067432b1-c59e-5c26-87a0-4d7cd455e8b7'
heat='ef63d21d-b554-5c58-86c0-970dd63ea8c5'
air='7f3e13fe-feaf-5b43-800d-5358ff2626bf'
want={cool,heat,air}
data=collections.defaultdict(dict)
for r in csv.DictReader(open(VALUES_CSV)):
    if r['timeseries_id'] in want:
        data[r['timeseries_id']][r['timestamp']]=float(r['value'])
days=set(ts[:10] for d in data.values() for ts in d)
print('date range sample', sorted(days)[:3], sorted(days)[-3:])
target='2018-01-27'
ts=[t for t in data[a] if t.startswith(target)]  # a is undefined, fix
ts=sorted(t for t in data[air] if t.startswith(target))
print('hours on day:', len(ts))
violations=[]
for t in ts:
    a=data[air].get(t); c=data[cool].get(t); h=data[heat].get(t)
    if a is None or c is None or h is None:
        violations.append((t,'missing',a,c,h)); continue
    if a < h-1e-9 or a > c+1e-9:
        violations.append((t,a,h,c))
print(len(ts), 'check hours; violations:')
for v in violations: print(v)
